sources.label: Morphe patches: Telegraph Plus (p2021) -> Graff. No ads/trackers/forced update,
sources.author: Graff
patch_list: Points the Graph Messenger remote config (ads ids, forced update version, update nag, recommended chats) and the Graph AI API to 127.0.0.1, so the app never contacts graphmessenger.com.

Changes the package to ir.finni.graff (configurable) so Graff installs next to the original Telegraph Plus. Rewrites the manifest (providers, permissions) and package strings in code. A renamed app is a separate app: it has its own login a…
Stops AppMetrica (Yandex) from sending data right after it is activated, turns off Firebase Analytics collection and removes the AppMetrica preload provider.
Required. Disables p2021's self signature check ("Your Telegraph Messenger is modified") and the hidden package name check that closes the app, so the re-signed app starts.
Renames the app (default "Graff") and replaces the default launcher icon with the Graff adaptive icon.
Replaces the welcome screen logo textures: a raccoon peeks over the Telegram sphere, signed "by Nott".
Stops the ad SDKs (AppLovin MAX, InMobi, AdMob mediation) from initialising, removes their auto-start providers and the advertising ID / Ad Services permissions.
Removes the "this version is no longer supported" dialog that blocks the app when the remote config marks the version as outdated.
Removes the "P2021_MODS - Subscribe / JOIN US" channel dialogs (on app start and in the mod settings).
